$comment: Expected outcomes of the checks of spec/media-upload/ (scripts/media-upload-plan.mjs explains each kind), under tla-ts (test-node/media-upload-spec/). A change of a count is a change of the state space: explain it in the commit.

variants.name: SlotBound-SlotNoCount
variants.breaks: S1 counts only processing slots, so a staging upload holds a slot the count misses (design 4.5 Capacity)

variants.name: ContainerCovered-DeleteFreesSlot
variants.breaks: DELETE frees the slot with the row, while the container runs (design 4.7: slots do not cascade)

variants.name: MaxContainers-DeleteFreesSlot
variants.breaks: DELETE frees the slot with the row, so a second upload's container starts beside the first

variants.name: StartNeedsSlot-SlotById
variants.breaks: the route's finally releases the slot by id after a lost queue reply (design 4.5's single release; C2-H2)

variants.name: SlotRelease-SlotById
variants.breaks: the route's finally releases a pending row's slot by id (C1, C2-H2, GM3)

variants.name: RouteDeleteAuthority-RouteCleansOnLost
variants.breaks: the route deletes incoming/<id> after a lost queue reply (C1, C2-H3)

variants.name: InputKept-OrphanStagingUnheld
variants.breaks: the orphan pass takes a staging row's key as unheld

variants.name: InputKept-NoWriteWindow
variants.breaks: S1 stages past the reservation's write deadline, so the sweep takes a live input at gc_at

variants.name: NoPublishAfterDelete-DeleteKeepsRow
variants.breaks: DELETE dooms but keeps the processing row, so S5 and S6 still authorize (K2)

variants.name: NoPublishAfterNon200-WaitForStoreDeadline
variants.breaks: S10 answers not_yet before deadline_at and the route answers 503 undoomed (Codex r4 H1)

variants.name: GrantBound-AbsGrant
variants.breaks: S5's grant compared as an absolute Store time on the processor's clock (C7)

variants.name: GrantGround-CompleteBeforeLanding
variants.breaks: S6 before the last write lands, so the URL is issued while a write can still land after DELETE (M3)

variants.name: V1Answer-CompleteBeforeLanding
variants.breaks: S6 before the last write lands, so v1 answers 200 for a file not yet stored

variants.name: ChargeOnce-ChargeTwice
variants.breaks: S3's repeat on a pending row charges the Store's counter again (Codex r1 CM5)

variants.name: RestoredInert-StartNoK3
variants.breaks: S4 without K3 starts a row reserved before the restore (C3, G5)

variants.name: Q4-RestoredAnswers500
variants.breaks: S10 answers 500 for a restored row (Q4)

variants.name: RecordDropSafe-MaintDropsRecord
variants.breaks: S4 answering maint with no container ends in deleteAll without D9 (Codex r4 H4)

variants.name: RecordDropSafe-ReleaseK3Stops
variants.breaks: S8 stops at K3 for a restored live row and the processor deletes its record (Codex r4 H2, Gemini r4 GH1)

variants.name: RecordDropSafe-ShortRecord
variants.breaks: the record-age stop before held_until (W9)

variants.name: SingleStaging-NoStagedMark
variants.breaks: S1 stages again after its staging row was removed (Codex r4 M1)

variants.name: PendingStarts-LongAlarm
variants.breaks: D1's alarm at TEARDOWN_MS (Codex r4 H3)

variants.name: RecordsCleared-MaintNoRetry
variants.breaks: S4's maint answer ends the invocation with its alarm deleted (GM7)

variants.name: ContainersStopped-StopNoRetry
variants.breaks: a stop that is not confirmed ends the invocation with its alarm deleted (Codex r4 M4, GM7)

variants.name: InputsDeleted-AgedKeepsInput
variants.breaks: the record-age stop leaves incoming/<id> of a completed upload

variants.name: SlotsReleased-NoExpiry
variants.breaks: the dispatch round never deletes a slot past held_until (W2)

variants.name: ContainerCovered-K3FreesSlot
variants.breaks: K3 deletes the slot of a restored pending or running row (C2-M1): the running container is no longer covered, and W3 does not excuse it, since the restore kept the slot (Gemini r1 GH1)

variants.name: SlotRelease-K3FreesSlot
variants.breaks: as above: a transaction other than S8 after the stop, or the expiry, removes a processing slot (Gemini r1 GH1)

variants.name: RestoredInert-QueueNoFence
variants.breaks: S3 queues a staging row reserved before the restore, without K3 or refused_cleanup_yours(restored) (Gemini r1 GH3)

variants.name: StartNeedsSlot-AbsStart
variants.breaks: the processor compares the Store's deadline_at with its own clock before the container start, so a processor behind the Store starts one at the deadline (Gemini r1 GH4)

variants.name: V1Answer-ShortGrace
variants.breaks: completion's gc_at no longer outlasts the v1 wait, so the sweep takes the upload between S10's 200 and the route's answer (Codex r1 CH1)

variants.name: NoLateObject-EarlyRetire
variants.breaks: the tombstone retires at the reservation + AV_WRITE_WINDOW_MS instead of + ORPHAN_GRACE_MS beyond it (Codex r4 M3; Gemini r1 GM1, Codex r1 CM4)

variants.name: InputsDeleted-SweepNoIncoming
variants.breaks: the sweep, reconciliation and the retirement leave incoming/<id> (Gemini r1 GM5)

variants.name: CompletedSwept-DoneNeverSwept
variants.breaks: the sweep never takes a completed unattached upload at its gc_at (D2)

variants.name: ChargeOnce-NoCharge
variants.breaks: S3 accepts an upload without charging it (Gemini r2 GM1, Codex r2 CM4, D10)

variants.name: SlotRelease-K3FreesSlotAtGrant
variants.breaks: K3 deletes a restored row's slot in S5 alone (Codex r2 CM4, D10)

variants.name: V1Answer-Done503
variants.breaks: S10 decides 503 for a completed upload and leaves it completed (Codex r2 CM5, D11)

variants.name: V1Answer-RestoredAnswers200
variants.breaks: S10 decides 200 for a restored reservation that never completed (Codex r2 CM6, D12)

variants.name: CompletedSwept-LateSweep
variants.breaks: the sweep takes a completed unattached upload one unit after its gc_at instead of at it (Codex r2 CM5, D11)

variants.name: ContainerCovered-GrantedLapses
variants.breaks: time frees a granted slot at its held_until, before HARD_HOLD_MS, so the container of a stop retried past the deadline runs without a counting slot (Codex r3 CH1, D16)

variants.name: MaxContainers-GrantedLapses
variants.breaks: as above: a later upload is admitted beside the container whose stop is retried (Codex r3 CH1, D16)

variants.name: ConfirmFenced-ConfirmNoFence
variants.breaks: S8, the stop confirmation, deletes the slot whatever its teardown_id, so a delayed call of another teardown frees it (Gemini r2 GM3, Codex r2 CM3, r3 CM2, D16, D20)

variants.name: RecordDropSafe-AgeBeforeHardHold
variants.breaks: the record-age stop at V2_PROCESS_MS + TEARDOWN_MS drops the record while the granted slot of a stop maintenance kept from confirming still counts (D16)

variants.name: V1Answer-LateRestored200
variants.breaks: S10 decides 200 for a restored reservation that never completed, once the route has answered: the late invalid 200 the r2 W12 excused (Codex r3 CM1, Gemini r3 GM1, D19)

variants.name: ContainerCovered-RestoreDropsGrant
variants.breaks: a restore that brings back a grant an earlier restore forgot drops its slot, so the running container has no counting slot once W3 ends (Codex r4 CH1, D24)

variants.name: StartNeedsSlot-W3AbsStart
variants.breaks: a start W3 excuses compares the Store's deadline with the processor's clock, so a processor behind the Store starts a container at the deadline (Codex r4 CM2, D25)

variants.name: MaintInert-MaintConfirmsDone
variants.breaks: S8 skips K1 for a completed upload, so a stop confirmation in maintenance deletes the slot (Codex r4 CM3, D26)

variants.name: NoLateObject-RetireIgnoresPurge
variants.breaks: the tombstone is retired at the write cut + ORPHAN_GRACE_MS whatever the purge's time, before main's max(purge, write deadline) + ORPHAN_GRACE_MS (Codex r4 CM4, D27)

variants.name: NoLateObject-DeleteAfterNoPurge
variants.breaks: the tombstone's delete_after ignores a purge after the write deadline (Gemini r5 GH1, Codex r5 CM4: the check computes the authority's end from the purge's time, not from delete_after)

variants.name: NoLateObject-DeleteAfterNoLand
variants.breaks: the tombstone's delete_after drops ORPHAN_GRACE_MS (Gemini r5 GH1)

variants.name: NoLateObject-QueueNoCap
variants.breaks: deadline_at is not capped at the reservation + AV_WRITE_WINDOW_MS, so a write starts after the window the tombstone's authority assumes (Gemini r5 GH1: the r3 bound, ORPHAN_GRACE_MS after the write's start)

variants.name: NoLateObject-RetireNoDelete
variants.breaks: the tombstone is retired without its last deletion of the keys (Codex r5 CM4)

variants.name: MaintInert-DispatchInMaint
variants.breaks: the dispatch round writes in maintenance (Codex r5 CM6: K1 checked for every step, not flagged per action)

variants.name: RestoreExact-RestoreMovesGrant
variants.breaks: a restore brings a granted slot back with granted_at moved to now (Codex r5 CM5)

variants.name: RestoreExact-RestoreDropsGrant
variants.breaks: a restore drops the slot of a grant an earlier restore forgot (Codex r4 CH1), caught by the restore's own check too

variants.name: V1Answer-Route503
variants.breaks: the route sends 503 for S10's 200 (Codex r5 CM3: the status sent is checked, not the reply received)

variants.name: V1Answer-S10IgnoresGc
variants.breaks: S10 answers 200 for a completed upload past its gc_at, whose files the sweep may have deleted before its row (Codex r5 CM2, D33)

variants.name: ContainerCovered-K3FreesSlot
variants.breaks: K3 deletes the restored ungranted slot of a container whose grant the restore forgot (Gemini r5 GM2: W3 excuses only once that slot has passed its held_until)

variants.name: NoLateObject-SharedEarlyPurge
variants.breaks: the Store takes every purge as before the write deadline, so a late purge's tombstone is retired at the reservation + AV_WRITE_WINDOW_MS + ORPHAN_GRACE_MS, before its authority ends (D41, Codex r6 CA3, CB1)

variants.name: StartNeedsSlot-MoveStartDeadline
variants.breaks: S4 moves deadline_at at the start, so a container starts past the deadline S3 stored (Codex r6 CB1)

variants.name: V1Answer-GiveUp200
variants.breaks: the route's give-up answers 200 for an upload not published (D42, Codex r6 CB2)

variants.name: NoPublishAfterNon200-NoDoomAtCut
variants.breaks: S10 answers 503 at the route's cut without dooming the upload, which then completes (D42, Gemini r6 GM2)

variants.name: OwnerGetHasFiles-CompleteBeforeLanding
variants.breaks: S6 completes the upload before its last write lands, so the owner's GET shows a URL without its file (D40)

variants.name: V1Answer-GiveUpOverReply
variants.breaks: the route's timeout answers 503 over an S10 decision it already received, a 200 included (D45, Codex r7)

variants.name: NoPublishAfterNon200-ClockOnlyW5
variants.breaks: W5 takes the route's clock past V1_TIME_MS as its ground whatever reply the route received, so a 503 S10 decided counts as one it did not (D45, Codex r7)
